periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonally oriented at approximately a 45-degree angle inward toward the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovoid morphology with the longitudinal axis significantly longer than the transverse axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward elongation with the lowest point of the patch shifted inferiorly relative to the ocular center.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Separation distance roughly equal to the transverse diameter of the upper cranium.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex, smooth semicircular curvature at the superior boundary.
